messages.text: Nabati reverses Arapaho Gold form in Mill Reef

metadata.summary: Nabati won the Dubai Duty Free Mill Reef Stakes (In Honour Of Ian Balding) for Charlie Appleby and William Buick at Newbury, beating Jolivette and race favourite Arapaho Gold.
metadata.content: Mill Reef Stakes: Charlie Appleby's Nabati reverses Arapaho Gold form at Newbury | Racing News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Mill Reef Stakes: Charlie Appleby's Nabati reverses Arapaho Gold form at Newbury Partnering Nabati, former Kingsclere jockey William Buick won the 2026 instalment of the Dubai Duty Free Mill Reef Stakes, which was run in honour of Ian Balding; Also on the card, Jack Nicholls won his first Group prize aboard Miss Yechance Saturday 19 September 2026 15:24, UK Image: Charlie Appleby saddled the Mill Reef Stakes winner, Nabati Nabati won the Dubai Duty Free Mill Reef Stakes (In Honour Of Ian Balding) for Charlie Appleby and William Buick at Newbury, beating Jolivette and race favourite Arapaho Gold. The Godolphin colt had been second to the Michael Dods-trained Arapaho Gold in the Listed Rose Bowl Stakes over course and distance in July, after which Arapaho Gold came out to land the Gimcrack. Nabati himself won at Newmarket, before most recently finishing third in the Flying Scotsman Stakes at Doncaster. Given a patient ride by Buick, the 7-4 chance edged Jolivette by a short head, with Arapaho Gold another neck behind in third. More to follow...
